correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the Fourier character multiplier 1+z+z^-1+w+w^-1+z/w+w/z. The all-orders step applies Mann relative-order bounds to minimal vanishing partitions and a rank-two lattice index at most 2; independently enumerated all 162 labeled no-singleton partitions with index distribution 0:3,1:150,2:9, the 3 rank-one cases being excluded by incompatible primitive-cube and antipodal constraints. This proves both torsion orders divide 420, so a 420^2 finite census is exhaustive. Independent modular evaluation over primes 421 and 2521 left 426 and 96 necessary candidates, intersection 48; exact cyclotomic divisibility of every survivor gives 12 conductor-7, 12 conductor-12, and 24 conductor-30 zeros. For the isolated conductor-7 pair of frequency lines, additive 7x7 matrices A(u)+B(v) with zero-mean A,B have at least 12 nonzero entries: the 37-zero extremum is attained only by matched (6,1) value multiplicities. The (7x7) crossing exhibits exactly 12 sites and 49 positions; group-component propagation yields c-rank([[r_j],[s_j]]) for arbitrary retained observations. The finite computation is exhaustive only because the independent torsion-bound proof supplies the cutoff.
